data.title: US lost 45 Reaper drones during Iran war, equaling 25% of stockpile | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: In May, Chief of Staff Gen. Kenneth S. Wilsbach told the House Armed Services committee that during the war, the Reaper was "perhaps the most valuable player."
